title: Carter's Tally
text:
Six barrels tallow to the Works. Four barrels lamp oil. Two sacks saltpetre, WET (not my fault, the Mire road).

Owed by the Renderers: nine silver. Paid: none. They say the vats have not been paid either.

Note to self. Do not take the lower road after dark. Tom took it. The cart came back.
